tools.name: check_legal_status
tools.description: The legal status of one peptide or GLP-1 drug in the United States (FDA), Australia (TGA), the UK (MHRA), the EU (EMA), Canada (Health Canada), Brazil (ANVISA, where covered) and sport (WADA), or in the one place you name. Returns each status with a plain-language note; for the U.S. also the full an

tools.name: status_in_place
tools.description: Every tracked peptide in one place, with its status and a note: use it for "which peptides are legal in Australia" or "what does WADA ban". Optionally only one status.

tools.name: list_compounds
tools.description: The 19 compounds Peptlas tracks, with the names people search by (brands, codes, street names), each U.S. status and its page. Use it to see what is covered.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Dated regulatory events from the Peptlas changelog, newest first: FDA advisory votes, list changes, comment deadlines, warning letters. Optionally for one compound or since a date. Use it for "what changed" or "any news on BPC-157".
